gloss: dressing table; vanity table; dresser with mirror

definitions.gloss: dressing table; vanity table; dresser with mirror
definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture with a mirror used for applying makeup and grooming. Traditionally an important item in a Japanese bride's trousseau.

examples.japanese: {鏡台|きょうだい}の{前|まえ}に{座|すわ}った。
examples.english: I sat in front of the dressing table.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}の{鏡台|きょうだい}には{小|ちい}さな{引|ひ}き{出|だ}しがたくさんある。
examples.english: My grandmother's dressing table has many small drawers.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{鏡台|きょうだい}の{前|まえ}で{丁寧|ていねい}に{化粧|けしょう}をしていた。
examples.english: Every morning, my mother would carefully apply her makeup in front of the dressing table.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, a {鏡台|きょうだい} was an essential item in a bride's {嫁入|よめい}り{道具|どうぐ} (trousseau). Japanese-style {鏡台|きょうだい} are low, designed to be used while sitting on the floor ({座|すわ}り{鏡台|きょうだい}). Western-style standing versions are also called {鏡台|きょうだい} or ドレッサー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鏡台|きょうだい}の{前|まえ}で (in front of the dressing table)
- {鏡台|きょうだい}の{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し (dressing table drawers)
- {鏡台|きょうだい}に{向|む}かう (to sit at the dressing table)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with the homophone {兄弟|きょうだい} (siblings).
